name: no-cohorts-month-end
about: The shape production sends until Q-AD34: no cohorts at all, on the last day of the month (0 days left).

output.headline: On October 31, 2026, 2 campaigns spent $284.25 to deliver 7 leads at $40.61 each across 14,600 impressions and 203 clicks.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the stronger performer: $184.50 spent, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks at a 1.5% click rate, and 6 leads at $30.75 each.
Dedicated night runs spent $99.75 for 5,480 impressions and 62 clicks at a 1.1% click rate, returning only 1 lead at $99.75 — notably higher cost per lead than Regional Class A — Joliet.
October 2026 closed today with $8,124.50 spent on Meta; no days remain in the month.
